evidence.says: LC gives the heading Vaughan, W. E. (William Edward), 1944-. Its source note for Irish historical statistics (1978) identifies William Edward Vaughan, born 1944, lecturer in modern history at Trinity College Dublin. It links VIAF 108830621, ISNI 0000000121471424, GND 140222782 and Wikidata Q112360434.

The item names William Edward Vaughan and describes a historian and emeritus fellow of Trinity College Dublin. It records birth year 1944, LC n79124167, VIAF 108830621, ISNI 0000000121471424 and GND 140222782, matching LC.
Requesting entity data for the QID linked by LC returns entity Q75853479, showing that Q112360434 resolves to the supplied item.
The graph’s Open Library author record names W. E. Vaughan and gives birth year 1944.

Works assigned to this author include Irish historical statistics, the title cited in LC’s identifying source note, together with Landlords and tenants in mid-Victorian Ireland and Murder trials in Ireland, 1836-1914.

notes: The lc_links_other_item flag reflects LC linking a redirected QID: Q112360434 resolves to Q75853479. Matching authority identifiers, affiliation and works support the identification. LC and Wikidata agree on 1944; LC attributes it to the 1978 book jacket.
